editorial:
Imagine living in a beautiful underwater city but feeling like you belong somewhere else. That is exactly what happens to Ariel, a curious mermaid who is obsessed with everything humans do. You will love how she sneaks away to collect treasures from shipwrecks and dreams of walking on land. The movie feels like a big, colorful party under the sea, and the chemistry between Ariel and Prince Eric is sweet and natural. It captures that feeling of being a teenager who just wants to explore the world and find where they truly fit in.

Halle Bailey does an amazing job with the singing, and her voice will honestly blow you away. The visuals are bright, though some of the underwater scenes can look a bit dark in places. It is a great pick for a family movie night because it has plenty of heart and funny moments with Flounder and Sebastian.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Ursula turns into a giant sea monster to take over the ocean. Eric manages to steer a large ship right into her, which finally stops her for good. King Triton sees how much Ariel loves Eric and realizes she belongs on land. He uses his magic trident to turn her into a human permanently. Ariel and Eric get married on a big boat, and the merfolk and humans finally live in peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves Disney classics and great music.
